verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for any developer tool with documentation, so the axis applies. A direct probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at gitleaks.io/llms.txt), and nothing in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation; the README and Action docs are standard human-facing docs.
